summary: Outline runs along motorway and ramp lanes; nowhere to stop.
reasons: Outline lies over live expressway and ramp lanes
No Stopping Any Time sign on the on-ramp
No pull-off, tracks or parked vehicles seen

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings nearby, but the line sits in open view of heavy motorway traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Traffic lanes and ramps, no pull-off or bays along the outline; a van would stop in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Constant motorway and ramp traffic on every side.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time on the on-ramp and motorcycle-only temporary parking signs; no vans seen.

flags: Outline is carriageway, not a car park
Low-lying: elevation about 2-3 m, Brisbane River 115 m away
No Stopping Any Time sign 5.1 m from outline
sun_shade: Open to sky; trees shade the north-east corner near the ramp.
cannot_judge: Whether the motorbike bays near the north end can be used by a van
